title: Ant Farm
shortDescription: A pixel-art ant colony simulation you start with a single queen.
description: A pixel-art colony simulation in the browser. You place the Queen and choose what she lays (gatherers, builders, nurses or soldiers), and the colony does the rest: digging tunnels, foraging, damming rain and fighting off raids. Ants path-find through a 288 by 144 tile world with water and sand physics and a day and night cycle.
